page_subtitle: A structured registry of academic submission format policies.
status_desc_endorsed: Community tool officially recommended/linked by the venue.
status_desc_discouraged: Venue prefers other tools, but might accept this.
notice_public_domain: By submitting, you agree that your contribution will be released into the public domain (CC0). Please ensure the information is accurate. Vandalism is strictly prohibited.
disclaimer_text: Disclaimer: This data is community-sourced and may not be accurate. Always check the official guidelines before submitting.
sponsor_lead: I make this registry and I've put several hundred dollars of my own into it. I don't have a job, and my small TA pay doesn't cover rent and food. Some days I can barely afford to eat.
sponsor_ask: Please help me keep going 🥺 Even one dollar helps me eat today.
sponsor_step_2: Pick any amount. Small is fine.
sponsor_step_3: Pay with PayPal or a card. No sign-up needed.
sponsor_company_hint: Companies are welcome to sponsor this site. Please write to mkpoli@mkpo.li.
sponsor_thanks: Thank you for reading this far. Your help keeps me fed and keeps this registry growing 💗
